What this prototype proves

The repair engine evaluates combinations of barriers and calculates which destination pairs become connected. The Delhi layout uses OpenStreetMap; other layouts are fictional. All barriers, costs and accessibility assumptions are hypothetical. A connected pair is a modeled journey, not a measured trip or a person helped.

Repair simulations do not certify accessibility. Real deployment requires inspected path conditions and feasible repair proposals.

DisabledAccess / working proof of conceptBuilt around complete journeys, not isolated repairs.
